mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS total FROM point_history ph WHERE mission_date LIKE CONCAT(#{selectedMonth}, '%') AND ph.is_deleted = 'N'

SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_points FROM point_history WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND mission_date LIKE CONCAT(#{selectedMonth}, '%') AND is_deleted = 'N' AND settlement_status = 'READY' AND category NOT IN ('FULL_ATTEND')

SELECT ph.user_no, u.user_nm, ph.user_id, DATE_FORMAT(mission_date, '%Y-%m') AS mission_month, -- 예: '2026-09' COUNT(CASE WHEN category = 'WORK' THEN amount END) AS work_count, SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'WORK' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS work_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'REFERRAL' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS referral_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'FULL_ATTEND' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS attend_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'leader_extra' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS leader_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'OVERPAY' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS overpay_amount, SUM(amount) AS total_point FROM point_history ph LEFT OUTER JOIN user u ON ph.user_no = u.id WHERE ph.user_no = #{userNo} AND mission_date LIKE CONCAT(#{selectedMonth}, '%') GROUP BY user_id, user_no, mission_month

SELECT c.campaign_title, c.time_segment as timeSegment, (CASE WHEN uc.status = '0' THEN '대기' WHEN uc.status = '1' THEN '출근' WHEN uc.status = '2' THEN '퇴근' WHEN uc.status = '3' THEN '지각' WHEN uc.status = '4' THEN '결근' WHEN uc.status = '5' THEN '무단' WHEN cl.status = '8' THEN '등록' WHEN cl.status = '9' THEN '퇴근' ELSE '없음' END) as status_nm, ph.mission_date, amount FROM point_history ph LEFT OUTER JOIN campaign c on c.campaign_id = ph.campaign_id LEFT OUTER JOIN user_campaign uc on uc.campaign_id = ph.campaign_id AND uc.user_no = ph.user_no AND uc.apply_date = ph.mission_date AND uc.status = '2' LEFT OUTER JOIN camp_leader cl on cl.campaign_id = ph.campaign_id AND cl.user_no = ph.user_no AND cl.apply_date = ph.mission_date AND cl.status = '9' WHERE ph.mission_date LIKE CONCAT(#{selectedMonth}, '%') AND ph.is_deleted = 'N' AND ph.settlement_status = 'READY' AND ph.user_no = #{userNo} AND ph.category = 'WORK'

SELECT ph.user_id, c.CAMPAIGN_ID, c.campaign_title, c.time_segment, MAX(uc_count.active_applicants) AS applicants_num, amount * MAX(uc_count.active_applicants) amount, mission_date FROM point_history ph LEFT OUTER JOIN campaign c ON c.campaign_id = ph.campaign_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT campaign_id, apply_date, -- 💡 1. 날짜 컬럼 추가 COUNT(*) AS active_applicants FROM user_campaign WHERE status IN ('2') AND apply_date LIKE CONCAT(#{selectedMonth}, '%') AND is_deleted = 'N' GROUP BY campaign_id, apply_date -- 💡 2. 날짜별로 GROUP BY ) uc_count ON ph.campaign_id = uc_count.campaign_id AND ph.mission_date = uc_count.apply_date -- 💡 3. 미션 날짜와 일치하는 데이터만 조인 WHERE ph.mission_date LIKE CONCAT(#{selectedMonth}, '%') AND ph.is_deleted = 'N' AND ph.settlement_status = 'READY' AND ph.user_no = #{userNo} AND ph.category = 'leader_extra' GROUP BY ph.user_id, c.CAMPAIGN_ID, c.campaign_title, c.time_segment, amount, mission_date

SELECT u.user_nm, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ph.mission_date ORDER BY ph.mission_date ASC SEPARATOR ', ') AS mission_date, SUM(ph.amount) AS amount, #{selectedMonth} AS mission_month, count(ph.point_id) point_cnt FROM point_history ph LEFT OUTER JOIN user u ON u.id = ph.source_no WHERE ph.mission_date LIKE CONCAT(#{selectedMonth}, '%') AND ph.is_deleted = 'N' AND ph.settlement_status = 'READY' AND ph.user_no = #{userNo} AND ph.category = 'REFERRAL' GROUP BY u.id, u.user_nm ORDER BY u.user_nm ASC

SELECT u.user_nm, amount, mission_date FROM point_history ph LEFT OUTER JOIN user u on u.id = ph.user_id WHERE mission_date LIKE CONCAT(#{selectedMonth}, '%') AND ph.is_deleted = 'N' AND settlement_status = 'READY' and ph.user_id = #{userNo} and category = 'FULL_ATTEND'

SELECT c.campaign_title as campaign_title, c.time_segment, (CASE WHEN uc.status = '0' THEN '대기' WHEN uc.status = '1' THEN '출근' WHEN uc.status = '2' THEN '퇴근' WHEN uc.status = '3' THEN '지각' WHEN uc.status = '4' THEN '결근' WHEN uc.status = '5' THEN '무단' WHEN lc.status = '8' THEN '등록' WHEN lc.status = '9' THEN '퇴근' ELSE '알 수 없음' END) as status_nm, reason_info, ph.mission_date, amount FROM point_history ph LEFT OUTER JOIN campaign c on c.campaign_id = ph.campaign_id LEFT OUTER JOIN user_campaign uc on uc.campaign_id = ph.campaign_id AND uc.user_no = ph.user_no AND uc.apply_date = ph.mission_date AND uc.status = '2' LEFT OUTER JOIN camp_leader lc on lc.campaign_id = ph.campaign_id AND lc.user_no = ph.user_no AND lc.apply_date = ph.mission_date AND lc.status = '9' WHERE mission_date LIKE CONCAT(#{selectedMonth}, '%') AND ph.is_deleted = 'N' AND settlement_status = 'READY' AND ph.user_no = #{userNo} AND category = 'OVERPAY'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS work_amount FROM point_history WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND category = 'WORK' AND settlement_status = 'READY' AND is_deleted = 'N' AND mission_date LIKE CONCAT(#{selectedMonth}, '%')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS leader_amount FROM point_history WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND category = 'LEADER_EXTRA' AND settlement_status = 'READY' AND is_deleted = 'N' AND mission_date LIKE CONCAT(#{selectedMonth}, '%')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS referral_amount FROM point_history WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND category = 'REFERRAL' AND settlement_status = 'READY' AND is_deleted = 'N' AND mission_date LIKE CONCAT(#{selectedMonth}, '%')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS attend_amount FROM point_history WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND category = 'FULL_ATTEND' AND settlement_status = 'READY' AND is_deleted = 'N' AND mission_date LIKE CONCAT(#{selectedMonth}, '%')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS work_amount FROM point_history WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND category = 'OVERPAY' AND settlement_status = 'READY' AND is_deleted = 'N' AND mission_date LIKE CONCAT(#{selectedMonth}, '%')
